_comment: The base config is read and patched in memory with modular_local_cond_configs; it is never copied, so it cannot drift from the published checkpoint.

training_overrides._comment: The published training block is ARC distillation (adversarial discriminator + MuonAdamW, with a placeholder ckpt path). Adapter training is a plain diffusion fine-tune, so arc/discriminator/EMA are removed and the optimizer is plain AdamW over the ~21M unfrozen beat projections.
